correctness.rationale: The algebra is a central extension satisfying the right Leibniz identity in every characteristic. Every AID can be normalized to kill the first generator; the second-generator image is constrained to the e3 and possibly en lines. The derivation recursion yields an explicit inner shift plus b E. E is a derivation, and a complete three-case analysis of all x proves it is almost inner iff theta3 is nonzero. E is non-inner then; the right annihilator is exactly K en, giving the dimensions and finite-field count. Direct checks span characteristics 2,3,5 and n=4..7, with eight full derivation-space enumerations. The finite checks are not used as infinite proof.
